description: Initial ground-truth labels for the three supplied sample projects. Labels are based on the current sample code and should be reviewed if the code changes.

task_1.title: Empty input can raise IndexError
task_1.rationale: first_item returns items[0] without checking whether items is empty.

task_2.title: Dynamic evaluation of input
task_2.rationale: calculate passes user_expression to eval, which can execute arbitrary Python expressions.

task_3.title: File handle may remain open on exception
task_3.rationale: If parse_config raises, handle.close is skipped. The practical impact depends on runtime cleanup and call frequency.
